fixes.explanation: False, and you caught the key word. Jesus says the rich “…have already received your comfort.” The key word is already. He doesn't say later, baker, He says already.

It's true. Jesus says, “If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also.” That's the exact line. It comes right after He says, “…pray for those who mistreat you.” So it's one of His examples of how to love your enemies: when someone strikes you, you turn the other cheek.
